Hosts and distribution. On Canscora diffusa (Gentianaceae) from Khandala, West India (Chiddarwar 1959) and on Vigna unguiculata (as Vigna catjang (Burm. f.) Walp.) from India (Bhat and Pratibha 2010). C. cf. canscorina is reported here for the first time for Benin and for Africa.
Distribution. China (Inner Mongolia); Russia; Mongolia; Korea (Lelej 2003).

Distribution. Southwest China (Aut. Reg. Xizang). The species is known only from its type-locality, Aut. Reg. Xizang, Linzhi, Hanmi, where it occurs in mountains at elevation 2200 m. Moths were collected in July.
Distribution. USA: Colorado (Gillette 1896; Lobato-Vila et al. 2019) and New Mexico (Lobato-Vila et al. 2019).
